title.zh: 将南三宝颜省 Molave 市镇 Parasan 描笼涯的 Simata 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Parasan 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Simata National High School - Parasan Annex in Barangay Parasan, Municipality of Molave, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur From the Simata National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Parasan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Simata National High School - Parasan Annex in Barangay Parasan, Municipality of Molave, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur From the Simata National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Parasan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Parasan của Trường Trung học Simata Quốc gia tại Barangay Parasan, Đô thị Molave, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Simata Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Parasan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Parasan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Simata แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Parasan เทศบาล Molave จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Simata แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Parasan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Parasan, Sekolah Menengah Simata Nasional di Barangay Parasan, Kotamadya Molave, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Simata Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Parasan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Parasan, Sekolah Menengah Simata Kebangsaan di Barangay Parasan, Perbandaran Molave, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Simata Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Parasan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Simata National High School – Parasan Annex in Barangay Parasan, Municipality of Molave, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the Simata National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Parasan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Simata National High School – Parasan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Parasan National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Parasan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Simata National High School – Parasan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
